Or in, especially in the case of Rachel Ziegler and Adrienne Warren, the fact that they're not white and so because of racism engraved in society, maybe the director just can't possibly see them in this world that they're clearly the right fit for. So, yeah, it's very accurate to have a Cathy that, that good and is just unable to make it in this world opposite a Jamie who could be talented, could be very average, but has a much easier time in the industry.
